cards.name: Weedle
cards.description: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

cards.name: Bunnelby
cards.description: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

cards.name: Fletchling
cards.description: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

cards.name: Furfrou
cards.description: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

cards.name: Chespin
cards.description: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

cards.name: Fennekin
cards.description: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Froakie
cards.description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

cards.name: Snubbull
cards.description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.
